title: Scotch Game: Mieses Variation
line: Black's knight attacks the center pawn; White trades knights and pushes the pawn to chase it.

steps.text: The Scotch Game. Black brings the knight out to attack your pawn on e4.
Trade knights first. A black pawn has to take back.

also.b1c3: Guarding the pawn with the knight is also played. This lesson trades.

steps.text: Push the pawn on e4 one square. It chases the knight.

also.b1c3: That is also played. This lesson pushes the pawn.
also.f1d3: That is also played. This lesson pushes the pawn.

steps.after: Black does not move the knight yet. The queen attacks your pawn, which cannot move away: your king is behind it.

steps.text: Put your queen in front of the king. It guards the pawn and blocks the black queen.

wrong.f1e2: That blocks the queen too, but then nothing guards the pawn on e5, and the queen takes it.

steps.after: Now the knight jumps to the center.

steps.text: Push the pawn on c2 two squares. It chases the knight again.
steps.after: Black's bishop pins your pawn to your queen.

steps.text: Guard the pawn on c4 with another pawn, so the pin costs you nothing.

also.g2g3: That is also played. This lesson guards the pawn first.
also.b1d2: That guards it too. This lesson uses the pawn.

steps.after: Your pawns hold space in the center and Black's pawns are split. Black has open lines for its pieces.

summary: Trade knights, then push the center pawn to chase the other knight. Guard that pawn with the queen.
